card.name: Inside bilirubin and split dose numbers
card.fires_on: The 'ub' piece in 'bilirubin' in liver-test monitoring text. It also fires on a middle digit inside a dose number such as 5600, 250 or 384.

modes.label: Inside bilirubin
modes.description: The 'ub' piece partway through 'bilirubin' in liver lab monitoring or dose-adjustment text.
modes.example: Monitor transaminases, bilir<<ub>>in, serum albumin, and international

modes.label: Middle digit of a dose number
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a multi-digit strength or dose, such as in a vitamin D amount or tablet strength.

card.plain: It lights up partway through the word bilirubin and on the middle digit of some dose numbers.
